mode: read-only production inspection; no service changes during preparation

beforeUpgrade.existingReverseProxy: Traefik routes to existing Next application

upgrade.preflight: Read-only unit/path validation before stopping or copying
upgrade.publicOAuthRoutes: Bounded loopback proxy in Next; no shared Traefik changes
upgrade.backup: Managed daily timer, logical data export excluding agent history; private directory and file permissions

limits: Host audit does not cover external provider snapshots or unmanaged off-host backups.
Local renderer/mock/compiled CLI checks do not alone prove deployed service health; exact-commit deployment acceptance is separate.
